name: rust-anything
stderr:
Rewrite TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, C, Go, Ruby, Java or Kotlin apps in Rust, one verified piece at a time

Usage: rust-anything <COMMAND>

Commands:
  analyze  1. Map a repository and write a ranked, ordered migration plan
  bridge   2. Scaffold a Rust crate with JS bindings for one unit
  refresh  2b. Regenerate the bindings (`lib.rs`, `index.cjs`, `js.rs`) from the signatures in `port.rs`
  record   3a. Record what the TS functions return on generated and given inputs
  build    3b. Build the crate's JS module (napi-rs `.node`, wasm-bindgen output) or, with `--profile android`, the JNI library for Android ABIs into `jniLibs/`
  diff     3c. Replay recorded cases against the Rust module
  bench    3d. Time the recorded cases on the TS original and on Rust, bridge included
  profile  Run a real workload under the language's profiler and say what to port: hot functions, their callers, and loops to batch. `rust-anything profile <repo> -- node bench.mjs` (also `python3 x.py`, `go test -bench . ./pkg`, `java ...`, `ruby x.rb`)
  shadow   4. Generate a drop-in module that runs TS and Rust side by side
  gate     5. Check the definition of done for a port
  app      Record the whole app's behavior and replay any build against it (CLIs)
  mcp      Serve every step as MCP tools over stdio
  setup    Register rust-anything with your coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode): the MCP server and, where the agent reads skills, the workflow skill. Keeps your other settings; run it again any time
  map      Map the port: every unit of the original, the crate that ports it, its cases and last diff, the whole app's glue, and which recordings the original changed past since they were made. Commit the map (`--write`) to see upstream changes in it
  doctor   Check the language runtimes, the agent setup and the MCP server, with the command that fixes each problem. Exits 1 when something required is missing
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version

Loop per unit: analyze -> bridge -> record -> port src/port.rs -> build -> diff -> shadow -> gate
